points.description: States that a C++ program begins executing at the main function (equivalent wording such as 'main()' or 'the main function' earns the mark).

deductions.description: Names a different function or entry point as the place where execution begins, such as a constructor, a header file or 'the first line of code' without naming main.

rubric.notes: The model answer contains one idea: execution starts at main. A student earns full marks for clearly naming main (or main()), in any equivalent wording. Any answer that names another function or location instead earns no marks.
